# Leveling a Warlock — what the bots run

**Recommendation (what the bots level with).** The party fixtures put this class on affliction (12 members), demonology (1 member), destruction (1 member). The main line is **affliction** — Build (levels 10-60), 35/11/5, no respec. Every order below is what the module grants level by level (the earlier builds first, then the level-60 build). [measured on bot runs, private 1.18.1-based realm — `knowledge/classes/warlock/*/talents.yaml`]

**This page is the bots' half.** It records which spec the bots level with, the talent order they execute level by level, the abilities their kit teaches and the consumables they carry. The hand-written guide for this class is [leveling.md](./leveling.md).

## Gameplay by level

The combat rules that come online in each bracket, in the loop's own order (ascending priority). `level_min` is the rule's own gate; the decision loop skips a rule until then. Rest, food and drink rules are left out here and their items are in the band tables below.

- **WA00d-demonic-sacrifice:** The guide's before-the-pull list begins there: "summon the Imp and Demonic Sacrifice it for +4% spell damage. Sacrifice the Succubus instead if you are threat-capped" (guide/classes/warlock/affliction.md L19; the effect table at L176-L180: Imp +4% spell damage, Succubus -10% threat, Felhunter mana regeneration; staff post Jamey 2025-07-25, and Soul Entrapment adds +6% with no demon out).
- **WA00t-voidstone:** The guide: "Carry a Felstone, or a Voidstone for threat" (guide/classes/warlock/affliction.md L19), "Stone: Felstone by default; Voidstone if threat is the problem" (L236), "Voidstone: -10% threat, 15% with Improved Stones" (L167: Afraido's table 90% threat with Demonic Sacrifice (Succubus) or Voidstone alone, 81% with both). Above WA00t-felstone on purpose: the walk reaches Voidstone, then Felstone, and each one's `not aura_self` on the OTHER stone's aura is what stops the pair trading auras every tick.
- **WA00t-felstone:** In OUR DB it is ITEM 51934, created by Create Felstone 51698 (spell_level 32, one Soul Shard), on-use spell 51697 (spell row L26505: a 30-minute dummy aura; the guide's words at L171: it returns 3% of damage dealt as healing and also heals the demon, with the same page's warning that the healing generates threat and can pull mobs onto the warlock). `not aura_self(52751)` as well as its own aura: the stones are one mutually exclusive personal buff, so the Felstone must not overwrite the Voidstone the rule above just applied for threat -- the walk reaches Voidstone first while threat is high, and this rule takes over only after that stone has expired.
- **WA01c-summon-succubus:** HO-TKB-PLAY-276 (amp-3 draft rot-mage-warlock.patch of 2026-10-18, rebased by tkb-play onto main with HO-270..274; the amp-3 text follows with the tkb-play gate: Level 60 only: the levelling guide keeps the Voidwalker as the solo demon until 60 (leveling.md L205, L221, L244, L270); the Succubus and the Felhunter are the 60 choices of the spec page.): THE SUCCUBUS HAD NO SUMMON RULE IN ANY OF THE THREE WARLOCK FILES (spec audit 2026-10-18, sub-60 gap 3; su damage pet from level 20 is named in the guide and the pet table, and only Imp and Voidwalker were ever summoned). The Succubus does more damage but is squishy" (L205), so this rule fires only when the warlock is alone and above 70 per cent health and the walk falls through to WA01d-summon-voidwalker-solo below it when it is not -- the Voidwalker stays the safe solo pet and this is the "many players switch" branch, not a replacement.
- **WA01e-summon-felhunter:** HO-TKB-PLAY-276 (amp-3 draft rot-mage-warlock.patch of 2026-10-18, rebased by tkb-play onto main with HO-270..274; the amp-3 text follows with the tkb-play gate: Level 60 only: the levelling guide keeps the Voidwalker as the solo demon until 60 (leveling.md L205, L221, L244, L270); the Succubus and the Felhunter are the 60 choices of the spec page.): THE FELHUNTER HAD NO SUMMON RULE EITHER, AND THE GUIDE GIVES IT ONE JOB: mana. "Felhunter: mana regeneration" (guide/classes/warlock/affliction.md L180), "sacrifice the Imp, or the Felhunter if mana is your limit" (guide/classes/warlock/destruction.md L23, L182: "sacrifice the Felhunter instead of the Imp to Life Tap less"), and the pet table calls it the utility/PvP pet (guide/classes/warlock/demonology.md, Pets section).
- **WA01-demon-armor:** HO-TKB-PLAY-013 (OQ-2568): out of combat this rule waits while the resident drinks or eats (aura 432, 433 or 435). - **WT08b-hellfire:** HO-TKB-PLAY-401: threat guard on the target (priority stays 83: a move to 64 waits for a channel stop from p1-loop); amp-6 review: rank 11684 Hellfire is a 296/s periodic self-damage aura (15 s = 172 per cent of a 2.5k warlock), r155 Ithbel cast it at 69 per cent and killed himself six seconds later, so the floor is 90 per cent and, in a party, a healer must be alive and the lowest member at 60 or more. No channel stop exists in the vocabulary, so the aura still runs until another cast ends it; the threat guard reads the current target only.
- **WT08-immolate:** In this file it is not one aura among four, it is the setup for WT05.
- **WT11-rain-of-fire:** THRESHOLD 4 IS THE ARCHIVE'S OWN: every one of the three warlock playbooks carries `aoe_threshold: 4`, and each puts Rain of Fire there by name -- Affliction "4+ stacked targets; Affliction has no AoE of its own", Demonology "Rain of Fire, condition: pack cleaves", Destruction "Rain of Fire, condition: melee cleave or fire-reflect makes standing in melee unsafe".
- **WT10f-drain-soul-finisher:** HO-TKB-PLAY-346 (amp-5 review of HO-330, the shard budget; leveling.md L186, L282, L283): Drain Soul on a dying non-boss target, so the warlock gets Soul Shards back the way a human does (finish with Drain Soul when you need shards). Why it is needed: the Soul Shard stacks to 3 (DB item 6265) and the kit carries a stack count agreed with p4-pioneer (2 stacks, 6 shards, for destruction and affliction, 1 stack, 3, for demonology; p4-pioneer change, before the 23:00 CEST regeneration; dropped to one stack if this finisher makes the second unnecessary after a round).
- **WT12w-shoot-trash:** HO-TKB-PLAY-065 (owner approved, via the orchestrator: wand earlier on trash, keep the full spells for bosses and big pulls; the warlock ended 10 of 56 round-86 fights under 20 per cent mana): the wand instead of the filler when the target is under 30 per cent health, or the warlock is under 40 per cent mana, in a fight that is not a boss or a big pull (`not (target.ttd_ms >= 15000)`: a target that will take 15 s or more is a long fight, null reads true; `enemies_engaged_within(30) <= 3`: four or more keep the spells; `party.pull_is_boss` is true only while a pull is imminent).
- **WT10a-wand-solo:** The guide for 4-9: "Corruption -> Immolate -> wand", from 8 "Curse of Agony -> Corruption -> wand"; and the bot-ready loop: "Nightfall proc -> Shadow Bolt. In a party nothing changes (`not (party.lowest_hp_pct >= 0)` is the solo test the rogue Stealth rule uses).
